cmd: F=/etc/cron.d/weather-tg; grep -q "weather_tg_review.py weekend" $F || printf "30 9,10 * * 4,5 root cd /opt/weather-tg && PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 /usr/bin/python3 weather_tg_review.py weekend >> run.log 2>&1\n" >> $F; grep -q "weather_tg_review.py week " $F || printf "30 15,16 * * 5,6,0 root cd /opt/weather-tg && PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 /usr/bin/python3 weather_tg_review.py week >> run.log 2>&1\n" >> $F; cat $F; echo CRON3_DONE
